simple.meaning: מוֹשָׁב (môwshâb) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a seat ; figuratively, a site ; abstractly, a session ; by extension an abode (the place or the time); by implication, population.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 10:30. The surrounding context includes family, land, mountain, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹשָׁב (H4186) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מוֹשָׁב (môwshâb) / H4186 is traced through Genesis 10:30, Genesis 27:39, Genesis 36:43, Exodus 10:23 with generated occurrence evidence.
